**STACKS OF FIBER FUNCTORS AND TANNAKA’S RECONSTRUCTION FABIO TONINI**

28 pp, 11 sections.

**Abstract.** Given a quasi-compact category ﬁbered in groupoids X and a monoidal subcat- egory C of its category of locally free sheaves Vect (X ), we are going to introduce the stack of ﬁber functors Fib X ,C with source C, which comes equipped with a map PC : X → FibX ,C and a functor G : C → Vect(FibX ,C). If C generates QCoh (X ) and X is an fpqc stack with quasi-aﬃne diagonal, we show that PC : X → FibX ,C is an equivalence, as it happens by Tannaka’s reconstructio n when X is an aﬃne gerbe over a ﬁeld. In general, under mild assumption o n C, e.g. C = Vect(X ), we show that Fib X ,C is a quasi-compact fpqc stack with aﬃne diagonal and that the image G(C) generates QCoh (FibX ,C).

**Outline.** Introduction; Notation; Acknowledgments; 1 Preliminaries; 1.2 Generalized frame bundles; 2 Pseudo-affine stacks; 3 Tannaka Reconstruction; 5 The stack of fiber functors; 5.1 Proof of Theorem 5.1; 5.2 Comparing vector bundles; References
